ffmpeg.source: official release tarball ffmpeg-9.1.tar.xz from https://ffmpeg.org/releases/
ffmpeg.build_id_note: Export reports use SHA-256 of this manifest file (baked into arc-media at build time as ARC_FFMPEG_MANIFEST_SHA256); this build_id names the source/profile/package pin.
notes: Native MSYS2 UCRT64 build: the spec cross-prefix is omitted because UCRT64 ships only unprefixed binutils; the compiler target is still x86_64-w64-mingw32/UCRT.
External libraries are linked dynamically; their runtime DLLs are shipped in bin/ and listed in files[].
Unstripped DLL copies live in .unstripped/ for symbolication and are not part of the shipped file set.

decisions.D1: LGPL version 2.1 or later (no --enable-version3, no version-3 libraries)
decisions.D2: Media Foundation excluded: no h264_mf / hevc_mf
decisions.D3: in-repo source build from the verified official tarball; no prebuilt package used
decisions.D4: P0 audit fixes (F-01, F-02, F-03, F-04, F-05, F-09) landed before the version switch
